name: Word Of Truth
overview: The Word of Truth is portrayed in Scripture as pure, enduring, and essential for spiritual life, as seen in Psalms where God's words are refined like silver and remain forever true. Jesus affirms that life depends not on physical bread but on every word that proceeds from God, highlighting its sustaining power. Furthermore, the Word is eternal and unchanging, surpassing even heaven and earth in permanence. Ultimately, the Word is embodied in Christ Himself, who is full of grace and truth, revealing God's faithful and living communication to humanity.
